articles.summary: See how much monthly income a $100,000 portfolio could generate at different income rates. Understand how investment income works, why payments can change, and why higher yield doesn’t always mean better returns. Explore income-paying investments and what to consider before spending or reinvesting the payments.
articles.title: How much passive income can $100,000 generate?

articles.summary: Your portfolio doesn’t stay the mix you picked. See what it turns into. What that slow shift could cost a $300,000 portfolio in a single bad year. Since 1926 there have been seven moments when rebalancing really mattered, and every one felt like the wrong time to do it.
articles.title: Does portfolio rebalancing improve returns? Not really, and that’s not the point
